recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser game named **Mushroom Meadow Hop** from this steering prompt: Mario platformer. A Mario platformer game with bright mushroom-kingdom energy, precise jumping, momentum-based movement, whimsical enemies, secret blocks, power-ups, cheerful adventure, and family-friendly arcade challenge with mobile-first controls, touch-friendly interactions, responsive readability, optimized on game start for portrait UI format, and the best-adapted mobile UX version targeting portrait aspect ratios in the 4:7 to 9:16 range.

Preserve the source mechanics: auto-running side-view platform movement, gravity, a single grounded jump on tap/click/Space/ArrowUp, platform-top collision, generated gaps, hazard strip failure, fall failure, coin collection worth 10 points, score HUD, game over with final score, and restart.

Regenerate the public surface as one inline HTML/CSS/JS canvas game. Use procedural mushroom-kingdom forms: sunny sky, rounded clouds, mushroom hills, grassy cap platforms, question blocks as visual feedback, gold coins, red/orange hazard strips, and grumpy mushroom pests. Keep mobile CTAs large, copy readable, and playfield taps separate from menu buttons.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is an auto-running 2D platform coin runner. The avatar moves right automatically, camera follows, gravity pulls the avatar downward, Space/ArrowUp/tap performs a jump only when grounded, generated platforms create gaps, coin collision adds 10 points, hazard strips and falling below the playfield trigger game over, and restart resets the run.

## Protected Mechanics
- Auto-run horizontal movement and momentum-like constant forward pressure.
- Grounded-only jump with gravity, vertical velocity, landing, and fall arcs.
- Platform top collision, generated gaps, hazard-strip fail state, and fall fail state.
- Coin collection radius, +10 scoring semantics, score HUD, game-over score, restart loop.
- Mobile tap/click/keyboard input semantics.

## Safe Transform Surfaces
Visual identity, HUD wording, procedural actor/enemy/coin/block art, animated background, audio choices, feedback particles, title/start/game-over copy, mobile UI styling, and progression labels can change without altering rules.

## Target Direction
Rebuild as **Mushroom Meadow Hop**, a bright mushroom-kingdom-inspired portrait runner where a cap-wearing meadow hero sprints across grassy cap platforms, collects coins, reveals secret-question-block feedback, and avoids grumpy mushroom hazard zones.
